# a11y.empty-headings — Heading has no text

- **Check ID:** `a11y.empty-headings`
- **Default severity:** `warning`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** WCAG 1.3.1, WCAG 2.4.6
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/a11y.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/a11y.empty-headings.md`](../a11y.empty-headings.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

A heading element has no text and no other accessible name.

## Why it matters

Screen reader users move through a page by jumping from heading to heading. An empty heading is announced as "heading level 2" with nothing after it, so they cannot tell what the section is or why the stop is there. Empty headings usually come from a template that prints a title which turned out to be blank, or from using `<h3>` for spacing.

## What it checks

Every `<h1>` to `<h6>`, and every element with `role="heading"`, whose content has no text. A heading is accepted when it holds text, an image with non-empty `alt`, or an element with a non-empty `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Headings hidden with the `hidden` attribute or `aria-hidden="true"` (on the heading or an ancestor) are skipped.

## How to fix

```html
<!-- before -->
<h2 class="section-title"></h2>

<!-- after: write the heading, or delete the element -->
<h2 class="section-title">Pricing</h2>
```

There is no automatic edit, because the report cannot know what the heading should say. If the element is only there for spacing, remove it and use CSS margin or padding instead.

## Options

None.
